title: Who he learned bass from: Vernon Gower and Walter Page
summary: He sat in with Gower's band; Walter Page was his influence.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: All right, you mentioned that Andy Anderson and Red Calendar gave you tips on the bass. Who else did you learn from?

The bass player that was with the Lorenzo-Picconny, his name was Vernon Gower. Now they use Elks to play Saturday dances at the L's Auditorium on Central and he'd let me come up and sit in with the band. He, would tolerate me, you know, and the band would be giving him the eye, you know, 'get on back up here.' He'd laugh and go and dance and get him a drink or something.
